<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par49 />the sequels in the future to preceding actions or events regarded as incomplete at the time of speaking, and therefore in the imperfect, imperative, or even participle. This {{GHGterm|wāw}} is in form an ordinary {{GHGterm|wāw copulative}}, and therefore shares its various vocalization ({{GHGheb|text=וְ}}, {{GHGheb|text=וּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=וָ}}, as {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=7|verse=4}}, and {{GHGheb|text=וַ}}); e.g. {{GHGheb|text=וְהָיָה}}, after an imperfect, &c., ''and so it happens = and it will happen''. It has, however, the effect, in certain verbal forms, of shifting the tone from the penultima, generally on to the ultima, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=הָלַ֫כְתִּי|translate=I went}}, consecutive form {{GHGheb|text=וְהָֽלַכְתִּ֫י|translate=and I will go}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=1|verse=3}}, where it is co-ordinated with another {{GHGterm|perfect consecutive}}, which again is the consecutive to an {{GHGterm|imperative}}. See further on this usage in § 112.

{{GHGmargin-letter|49|i}}
As innumerable examples show, the {{GHGterm|Qameṣ}} of the first syllable is retained in the strong perf. consec. Qal, as formerly before the tone, so now in the secondary tone, and therefore necessarily takes {{GHGterm|Metheg}}. On the other hand, the ''ō'' of the second syllable in verbs ''middle ō'' upon losing the tone necessarily becomes ''ŏ'', e.g. {{GHGheb|text=וְיָֽכָלְתָּ֫}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=18|verse=23}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|49|k}}
The shifting forward of the tone after the {{GHGterm|wāw consecutive}} of the {{GHGterm|perfect}} is, however, not consistently carried out. It is omitted—(''a'') always in the 1st ''pers. pl.'', e.g. {{GHGheb|text=וְיָשַ֫בְנוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=34|verse=16}}; (''b'') regularly in Hiphʿil before the afformatives {{GHGheb|text=־ָה}} and {{GHGheb|text=וּ}}, see {{GHGpar|53|r}}; and (''c'') in many cases in verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, almost always in the 1st sing. of {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=29|verse=14}}), and in {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} if the vowel of the 2nd syllable is ''î'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=17|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=26|verse=4.6.7.10|hidebook=1}} ff., {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=6|verse=26}}, &c., except in {{GHGterm|Qal}} (only {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=24|verse=5}}, before {{GHGheb|text=א}}) and the 2nd sing. masc. of Hiphʿil-forms before {{GHGheb|text=א}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=20|verse=8}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=20|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=15|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=13|verse=17}}; similarly in Piʿēl before {{GHGheb|text=א}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=25|verse=24}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=27|verse=4}}. On the other hand the tone is generally moved forward if the second syllable has ''ê'' (in {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=10}} &c., in {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=40|verse=4}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=33|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=32|verse=7}}); but cf. also {{GHGheb|text=וְיָרֵ֫אתָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=19|verse=14.32}} and frequently, always before the counter-tone, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jo|chapter=4|verse=21}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=19|verse=14}}.<ref>The irregularity in the tone of these perfects manifestly results from following conflicting theories, not that of Ben Asher alone.</ref> With ''ā'' in the penultima the form is {{GHGheb|text=וְנָשָׂ֫אתָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=14|verse=4}}, and probably also {{GHGheb|text=וְקָרָ֫אתָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=2|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=3|verse=12|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=10|verse=2}} with little Tēlîšā, a postpositive accent.

{{GHGmargin-letter|49|l}}
But before a following {{GHGheb|text=א}} the ultima mostly bears the tone on phonetic grounds, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=וּבָאתָ֫ אֶל־}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=6|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=3|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=6|verse=10}} (by the side of {{GHGheb|text=וּבָ֫אתָ}}), &c. (cf., however, {{GHGheb|text=וְקָרָ֫אתָ}}, before {{GHGheb|text=א}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=17|verse=19}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=7|verse=27}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=36|verse=29}}); {{GHGheb|text=וְהִכִּיתָ֫ אֶת־}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=6|verse=16}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=25|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=24|verse=5}} (but also {{GHGheb|text=וְצִוִּ֫יתִי אֶת־}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=25|verse=21}}). Likewise, before {{GHGheb|text=ה}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=8|verse=9}}, and {{GHGheb|text=ע}}, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=26|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=12|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=26|verse=25}} (cf., however, {{GHGheb|text=וְקָרָ֫אתִי עָלָיו}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=38|verse=21}}); on verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, see {{GHGpar|67|k}} and ee.

{{GHGmargin-letter|49|m}}
(''d'') The tone always keeps its place when such a perfect stands in {{GHGterm|pause}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=6|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=11|verse=15|hidebook=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=וְאָמָ֑רְתָּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=14|verse=4}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=4|verse=8}}; sometimes even in the lesser pause, as {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=2|verse=28}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=3|verse=26}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=29|verse=8}} (where see Driver), with {{GHGterm|Zaqeph qaṭon}}; and frequently also immediately ''before'' a tone-syllable (according to {{GHGpar|29|e}}), as in {{GHGheb|text=וְיָשַׁ֫בְתָּה בָּ֑הּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=17|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=14|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=17|verse=22|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=1|verse=4.7.10.12}}—but also {{GHGheb|text=וְחָֽשַׁקְתָּ֫ בָ֔הּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=21|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=23|verse=14|hidebook=1}}. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=24|verse=19|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=8|verse=46}}.<section end=par49 /><noinclude>
<references/></noinclude>
